tasks.label: 🚀 启动全部服务 (Go + Python + Vue)
1. 启动 Go 后端 (8080)
tasks.command: powershell -NoExit -Command "cd backend; if (Test-Path medtrust_backend.exe) { Write-Host '正在启动编译好的 medtrust_backend.exe...' -ForegroundColor Green; .\medtrust_backend.exe } else { Write-Host '正在编译运行 main.go...' -ForegroundColor Green; go run ./cmd/main.go }"

tasks.label: 2. 启动 Python AI Agent (8000)
tasks.command: powershell -NoExit -Command "cd ai_agent; Write-Host '正在启动 Python FastAPI 受控 AI Agent (端口 8000)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"

tasks.label: 3. 启动 Vue 前端 (5173)
tasks.command: powershell -NoExit -Command "cd frontend; Write-Host '正在启动 Vue 3 + Vite 前端 (端口 5173)...' -ForegroundColor Magenta; npm run dev"
